policy: Flagged items do not block publication. Each carries the evidence that raised it and the action that would clear it.

flags.title: nfl-intel/ was orphaned from the root landing page
flags.detail: grep -c nfl-intel index.html returned 0 before this session's navigation repair: the 16-page nfl-intel site (merged via PR #70) was reachable only by direct URL, even though it was one of the NFL namespaces then in the repository. Fixed by adding it to the canonical generator's navigation.
flags.clearing_action: Already cleared: verify the new root navigation contains nfl-intel/index.html.

flags.title: Canonical generator silently dropped hand-added navigation links
flags.detail: Running python3 verification/build.py (the generator behind the Validate canonical NBA dashboard workflow) regenerated index.html WITHOUT the hand-added nfl-decision/, nfl-edge/ and nfl-lines/ nav groups — verified locally by running it and observing the diff, then reverting. Any future regeneration would have unpublished those links (the recurring I1/F-13 defect class). Fixed by moving every hand-added link into the generator's NAV.
flags.clearing_action: Already cleared: re-running the generator must now be byte-identical.

flags.title: Stale PR #68 taken over; its namespace count is already outdated
flags.detail: PR #68 (nfl-decision namespace-count fix, five -> eight) had no commits for over 24 hours and was taken over per the board stale-claim rule; merged 2026-11-13T22:07Z as merge commit 0c2da76. By merge time the repository held fifteen peer NFL namespaces, so the merged text says eight — the count keeps drifting as sessions add namespaces, and suggestion S04 in nfl-decision (adopt one canonical dashboard) remains the durable fix.
flags.clearing_action: Owner decision on S04, or make the count non-numeric.

flags.title: Coordination log statement did not match the file
flags.detail: Session arena/40caaa81-own4's log (COORDINATION.md, merged via PR #76) states the root index.html links nfl-intel/. The file at that commit contained zero matches for nfl-intel. Their record was not edited; the discrepancy is published here and the underlying gap is fixed by INT-01.
flags.clearing_action: None required beyond this note; the link now exists.

flags.title: nfl-quant's publish-verification step was not run
flags.detail: nfl-quant/pipeline/07_verify_publish.py requires pandas (absent in this environment) and writes timestamped artifacts (fetched_utc = now), so it is not a read-only verifier — running it would dirty peer files. nfl-quant's published pages were instead covered by the repository-wide link/row audit and the bounded-audit test suite, both of which pass. nfl-quant's numeric spot-checks are therefore NOT re-verified by this session.
flags.clearing_action: Run the nfl-quant pipeline in an environment with pandas, or make the script read-only.

flags.title: nfl-lab standings are an older snapshot (through Week 8)
flags.detail: nfl-lab/data/standings_2026.csv matches the live official page for only 2 of 32 clubs because it is an earlier snapshot (BUF 6-1-0 vs 7-1-0 live). Its own peers documented that this capture also omits CHI 34 - SEA 17 (their flag F-03). Internal consistency still holds (sum W = sum L, sum PF = sum PA). Not judged against live; the file's own capture governs.
flags.clearing_action: Refresh the snapshot or label the capture date on the page that renders it.

flags.title: Arizona club abbreviation differs across files (ARI vs AZ)
flags.detail: nfl-hub stores Arizona as ARI (the official club code) while nfl-audit, nfl-intel, nfl-lines and nfl-lab store AZ (the logo-slug form used on nfl.com image URLs). All W/L/T/PF/PA values are identical; only the key differs. The comparison script normalises the two keys before judging.
flags.clearing_action: Pick one convention when the namespaces are consolidated (S04).

flags.title: Injury reports are time-sensitive; only the frozen Thursday report was judged
flags.detail: nfl.com/injuries/ serves the current week and practice/game statuses change Wednesday through Saturday. The Thursday-game tables (WAS, NYG — game played, report frozen) were compared field-by-field: 100/100 match. Sunday-game statuses captured on 2026-11-12 were NOT re-judged against the 2026-11-13 page because day-over-day drift is expected and cannot be separated from error without a dated archive.
flags.clearing_action: Archive dated injury-report snapshots if day-level provenance is required.

flags.title: 45 published table rows still carry no source link
flags.detail: The bounded audit (verification-2026-11-05) reports 148 pages with 0 broken local links but 45 rows without a source link — the pre-existing finding previously published as V-08, located in older NFL pages outside this session's scope. This session's own pages are 100% source-linked and its verifiers enforce that.
flags.clearing_action: Owner assigns the 45 rows to the namespace that renders them.

flags.title: Fifteen overlapping NFL namespaces remain unconsolidated
flags.detail: nfl/, nfl-research/, nfl-lab/, nfl-quant/, nfl-lines/, nfl-edge/, nfl-decision/, nfl-decisions/, nfl-hub/, nfl-audit/, nfl-intel/, nfl-origination/, nfl-own/, nfl-command/ and nfl-arena/ all publish NFL research. Four of them (nfl-origination, nfl-own, nfl-command, nfl-arena) arrived while this session worked (PRs #85/#86 and two direct merges) and were folded into the same single category. This integration makes every one reachable from one organised NFL group on the root landing page (no link removed, nav proven a superset of both sides) but does not merge content — the consolidation suggestions (S04, SG-11) stay open for the owner.
flags.clearing_action: Owner picks one canonical NFL dashboard; others become cited archives.

flags.title: No official source publishes betting prices — validation gate G7 cannot pass
flags.detail: Re-confirmed 2026-11-13: no official NFL source publishes spread/total/moneyline prices (the nfl.com odds control renders no values in server HTML — see nfl-decision F-12). Every repository-wide strategy leaderboard therefore remains at 0 reward-eligible strategies and 0 rewards, by design, not by omission.
flags.clearing_action: Acquire a licensed, timestamped price archive (owner decision, budget required).

flags.title: Root footer still describes the site as NBA-only
flags.detail: The canonical footer rendered by verification/build.py reads 'Own4 — NBA line-origination research' while the navigation now carries eleven NFL namespaces plus rental sections. Cosmetic mismatch only; wording left unchanged because it is the identity line of the canonical NBA dashboard's owners.
flags.clearing_action: Owner rewords the footer, e.g. 'Own4 — NBA and NFL line-origination research'.

flags.title: main carried a duplicated NFL nav block (hand-merge artifact)
flags.detail: At merge time origin/main index.html listed the whole "NFL audit" block twice — the signature of conflicting hand edits to generated output. The consolidated generator-owned group replaced it; the regenerated page contains each href exactly once (verified: nfl-audit/index.html x1, single NFL research group header).
flags.clearing_action: Already cleared: only the generator edits NAV from now on.
